QuestInfo.name: Allen, Father of Robots
QuestInfo.0: It seems Allen hasn't heard about the #MDmirrorD_325_3_# robots. Maybe you should tell him since he is the one that made them after all?
QuestInfo.1: Allen is very sad of the news of robots in #MDmirrorD_325_3_# and asks that you go get parts to repair the robots before Anthony completely destroys the android.
QuestInfo.2: You recovered the parts to fix the android as Allen has requested.

0.0: What? You got rid of the broken Guard Robot and the Security System in #MDmirrorD_325_3_# because Anthony the vice president asked you to? Ugh... How can this be? Those broken guys only needed minor repairs and they would have been okay.
0.1: I am sure vice president Anthony will try to get rid of the androids as well. I will need to have the androids fixed before than. They are robots but they were made with my own hands. They are like my children. Will you help me?

yes.0: Robots become good as new as soon as you change out the broken parts. So go get me the broken #r#t4009050##k and #r#t4009051##k. I can't fix all the broken ones at once so go get me #r10#k each for now.

no.0: I cannot sit back and watch robots, that I consider my children, be treated as junk.

1.0: Did you bring me the broken parts?

yes.0: Let's see... The filament in the light bulb had gone out. It seems part of the android's parts are corroded so I think the robot will work fine if we fix this part.

default.0: Hurry and bring me #r10#k #r#t4009050##k and #r#t4009051##k before vice president Anthony decides to have them junked.
